parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001', max_tokens: 300, temperature: 0, system: "You classify WhatsApp messages from construction and workshop crews about inventory.
Catalog SKUs: EPP-CASCO (safety helmet), EPP-GUANTE (work gloves), EPP-LENTE (safety glasses), FLT-ACEITE (oil filter), MAT-CEMENTO (cement bag 25kg).
Return ONLY a JSON object with these keys:
intent: "stock_movement" | "stock_query" | "other"
sku: one catalog SKU, or null
type: "in" | "out" | null (only for stock_movement)
quantity: integer or null (only for stock_movement)
confidence: number from 0 to 1
needs_human: boolean
reason: short string
Rules: never invent a quantity that is not written in the message; if the product is not in the catalog, or the message is ambiguous, a complaint, or asks for a person, set needs_human to true.", messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.text }] }) }}
